summary:
**Status: partial** — B3's SDPA-bug question is answered (not reproduced) with MPS-vs-CPU micro-data; B2 peak RSS and full B3 warm latency are **blocked** (no weights cached, none downloaded per constraints). Repo untouched; all work in `/tmp/cyv-b23-3107`.

## Hardware label

Apple M1, 8 GB RAM, macOS 27.2 (build 26B118), torch **2.14.1** (macOS arm64 wheel, fresh pip install into scratch venv), Python 3.14.8, `PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1`. `torch.backends.mps.is_available()` = True.

## Cache state (why B2 is blocked)

`~/.cyv/models` does not exist; no `.cyvpack.zip`, `rmvpe.pt`, `kokoro-v1_0.pth`, or `model.pth` anywhere on disk; `~/.cache/huggingface` holds only an unrelated faster-whisper model. Full B2 needs ≈ 887 MB of downloads (RMVPE 181 MB + ContentVec 378 MB + Kokoro 327 MB + voices) plus the Applio checkout at pin `c817f1f8` plus a trained voice pack — none fetched, per the no-weight-download constraint. B2 verdict: **blocked-with-reason, needs `cyv setup` + a real pack on this Mac.**

## Summary table (measured via `/usr/bin/time -l`, 2 runs each, stable)

| Component | Device | Latency | Peak RSS |
|---|---|---|---|
| python3 baseline | — | — | ~14.6 MB |
| torch 2.14.1 import only | — | — | ~222 MB |
| SDPA HuBERT-shape (1,8,500,64) fp32 | MPS | 1.30 ms/call | — |
| same | CPU | 1.39 ms/call | — |
| SDPA fp16 | MPS 1.01 ms / CPU 22.65 ms | — | — |
| `nn.MultiheadAttention` 768/12×500 frames | MPS 6–7 ms / CPU ~12 ms | MHA workload total: MPS ~370 MB / CPU ~267 MB | — |
| 2× HuBERT-ish encoder blocks | MPS ~3.1 ms / CPU ~6.0 ms | — | — |
| HuBERT+RMVPE+Kokoro+1 voice (real B2) | — | — | **blocked** |
| Warm 10 s line, end-to-end (real B3) | — | **blocked** | — |

## SDPA bug reproduced? **No**

Zero failures across SDPA (plain, `is_causal`, bool mask), `nn.MultiheadAttention`, and a 2-block encoder, fp32 and fp16, MPS and CPU. No `placeholder storage has not been allocated` / Metal errors. The macOS-26-era MPS SDPA bug **does not reproduce on torch 2.14.1 + macOS 27.2** (likely fixed by newer torch/OS; the original report predates both). MPS CPU-fallback path verified working (`torch.linalg.svd` on MPS falls back cleanly with the flag set), so engine.py's `_MPS_MARKERS` retry logic remains valid as insurance but did not trigger.

## MPS-vs-CPU policy recommendation (provisional, micro-benchmark only)

- **Attention/transformer parts (HuBERT/ContentVec, Kokoro): MPS** — ~2× faster than CPU at fp32, ~22× at fp16, modest +~100 MB RSS cost. No correctness reason to avoid MPS on this stack.
- **Keep the existing per-call CPU retry** (`engine.py::_MPS_MARKERS`) and `PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1`: fallback verified functional, costs nothing when unused.
- **RMVPE (conv pitch tracker) and FAISS index: CPU** — unchanged from design; no data to move them.
- **Do not quote** the ms/call numbers as B3 latency: they exclude weights, RMVPE, vocoder, FAISS lookup, and Kokoro text frontend. Real B3 needs one `cyv setup` + voice pack + a 10 s line timing.

## Commands run (all in `/tmp/cyv-b23-3107`, repo never modified)

- `python3 -m venv` + `pip install "torch>=2.6" numpy` (torch 2.14.1; satisfies repo's torch≥2.6 floor)
- `sdpa_probe.py` (env/MPS availability), `sdpa_test.py` (SDPA shapes × devices), `mha_test.py` (MultiheadAttention, masks, encoder blocks, svd fallback)
- `/usr/bin/time -l … rss_work.py [cpu|mps]` plus import-only baselines
- `find` hunt for weights; `grep` of `models.toml` sizes and `pin.py`

## Not verified

- Real B2 peak RSS (needs ~887 MB weights + Applio checkout + trained voice).
- Real B3 warm latency for a 10 s line (same prerequisites).
- Whether the SDPA bug reproduces on the *original* stack (older torch on macOS 26) — only the current stack was tested.
- AudioSeal-on-MPS cost (weights absent); Linux B4 numbers stand.
- Scratch venv left at `/tmp/cyv-b23-3107` (venv + 4 scripts); safe to delete.
